items.title: 53279_Lee Young Oral History Interview
items.q: the man who arranged for your band at the Alabam... Frank Comstock, that's right.

ctx.x: Uh huh. And the name of the man who arranged for your band at the Alabam who you said later became big in TV music?
Comstock. His name was Comstock. Now I'm not sure if it was Fred Comstock.
